## MandEval

*Effectiveness and consequences of Australia's COVID-19 vaccine mandates.*
Australian Department of Health and Aged Care, Medical Research Future Fund, Early
to Mid-Career Researchers scheme. Identifier MRF2019107, running 2023 to 2025.

The University of Newcastle component is A$808,440. The full multi-institution
programme award is A$4,754,183.37. These are different figures and are not
combined anywhere on this site.

[Grant record](https://www.grants.gov.au/Ga/Show/57849742-1674-4b10-b75a-47d575e5d430) ·
[About the project](/research/projects/mandeval/)

## Upscaling FETP in India: business case

Commissioned by the World Bank Group, International Bank for Reconstruction and
Development. March to December 2025, $416,000.

With M. Wu, J. Henriquez, A. Gebremariam, A. Melia and collaborators.

[About the project](/research/projects/fetp-india/)
